description: Block the catalog scraper ASN already rejected by the application
expression: (http.host eq "dsh.fish" and ip.src.asnum eq 214483 and not cf.client.bot)

description: Challenge filtered browse document URLs in all locales; preserve API, data and Markdown clients
expression: (http.host eq "dsh.fish" and (http.request.uri.path wildcard "*/browse" or http.request.uri.path wildcard "*/browse/") and http.request.uri.query ne "" and not (lower(http.request.headers["accept"][0]) contains "markdown") and not cf.client.bot)
